summary: Idaho County, ID ridge; L-4 cab on 30-ft pole tower, built about 1939 (1934 in one inventory), destroyed 1950. Nez Perce NF since 1957. No current description.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1950; no source describes what remains on the ridge today

resolved_conflicts.explanation: An undated inventory gives 1934 for the 30-foot L-4 tower; later lists citing Kresek, and the Idaho and firelookout.com pages, give 1939. The record keeps 1939; the story notes both dates.

notes_for_editor: Location conflict not resolved: the record's ffla point (46.0566, -114.7576) matches the FFLA list (46.05660, -114.75760), but the idaho_fl point (46.07873, -114.7404) appears in no source read. Check which point is the lookout before any location change. Build year is disputed (1934 vs about 1939). Agency corrected from Bitterroot NF to Nez Perce NF. Nothing describes the site today.
